nodes.label: Interior Dining Area with Graffiti Mural
nodes.description: Interior shot of The District Tapas & Bar restaurant dining area featuring a prominent graffiti-style mural on the white wall. The mural displays the restaurant name 'The District' in bold teal/turquoise graffiti lettering with the tagline 'Tapas x Bar' beneath it. The artwork includes colourful cartoon-style illustrations: a Sydney Harbour Bridge silhouette, stylised trees with sunglasses, a guitar, spray cans, a boombox, a frog, a penguin character, and various urban/pop-art motifs rendered in pink, teal, black, and green. The foreground shows dark leather booth seating and light wood dining tables set with menus and small table lamps. The ceiling is painted black. The overall mood is vibrant, urban, and youthful with a street-art aesthetic that communicates a casual-cool brand identity.
nodes.visual_style: street-art graffiti mural, pop-art illustration, high-contrast, colourful
nodes.purpose: brand identity showcase, interior ambiance photography for restaurant website
